title: Bulgur, Mung Bean and Chickpea Pilaf
subtitle: with caramelised baby onions
description: Bulgur cooked with mung beans and chickpeas, topped with buttery caramelised shallots.

steps.text: Cook the mung beans in a pot with plenty of water for about 20 minutes until tender. Drain.

Meanwhile, caramelise the shallots: heat the oil and butter in a pan, add the peeled whole shallots, cover and cook on medium-low heat for about 10 minutes until soft. Uncover and cook for about 5 minutes until the liquid evaporates and the shallots are glazed golden brown. Season with salt.

Fry the finely chopped onion in the oil and butter in a pot for about 5 minutes until lightly golden. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the rinsed and drained bulgur and stir to coat in the oil.
Add the mung beans, chickpeas, salt and water and bring to the boil. Cover, lower the heat and simmer gently for about 30 minutes.
Transfer to a serving bowl, scatter over the shallots and serve.
